locationCode.description: The full seven-segment code. Its Site/Area/Zone/Aisle segments must resolve to existing, Active aggregates.

dockFlow.description: Required when the LocationType's role is Dock; rejected for every other role.

activities.description: Required (non-empty) when the LocationType's role is WorkCenter; rejected for every other role.

allOf.description: A slot's physical envelope. Both dimensions must be strictly positive.
allOf.title: Capacity

capacityOverride.description: Optional. Omit to inherit the LocationType's default envelope.

handlingUnit.description: The unit of handling a slot accepts (ADR-0040). Absent on a slot means none was recorded.
handlingUnit.title: HandlingUnit

gln.description: A GS1 Global Location Number (ADR-0045): 13 digits whose last digit is the GS1 mod-10 check digit of the first twelve (weights 3 and 1, alternating from the right). The pattern only checks the shape; the check digit is verified by the service (422 `invalid-gln`). A GLN identifies exactly one site, zone or slot (409 `gln-already-assigned`). Optional everywhere; omitted when none was recorded.
gln.title: Gln

spotKind.description: What a yard spot is for (ADR-0045). Only meaningful on a slot whose role is `Yard`; omitted when none was recorded.
spotKind.title: SpotKind

storageBin.summary: A storage bin without the optional identity fields

yardSpot.summary: A refrigerated-trailer yard spot with a GLN (ADR-0045)
